_comment: Reference only. Phase 0 reads the host's model list and freezes the policy in a private policy directory: THINK and VERIFY are always host-owned (inherited); BUILD is host-owned, or the literal the user chose from that list after the recommendation in references/model-policy.md. No model name is written in the skill. No mid-run substitution except back to the host model.
think: REPLACE: strongest available agentic coding/reasoning model
verify: REPLACE: independent rigorous review model, never weaker than bulk
